description: Generated by scripts/build-screen-assets.mjs from committed benchmark artifacts. Do not edit: every figure here is read from a benchmark file, and the first entry is first on purpose.

limitations.title: The evidence model is validated on cancers; India's disease burden is mostly not cancer
limitations.detail: The evidence ranking was validated on a panel where 9 of the 10 contributing held-out diseases were cancers, and on the one non-cancer disease it did not beat counting publications (0.730 against 0.722). India's recorded burden runs the other way: malignant neoplasms are 6.0% of total DALYs, while large non-cancer causes include ischaemic heart disease (44,234k DALYs), stroke (27,299k DALYs), chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (25,679k DALYs), diabetes mellitus (24,230k DALYs) and tuberculosis (14,015k DALYs). So screening a high-burden Indian disease puts the ranking outside the range where it was validated — which is the screen's intended use. Treat the order of rows for any non-cancer disease as unvalidated.

limitations.title: The evidence score is an oncology result
limitations.detail: Held-out ROC-AUC 0.721 on a panel where 9 of the 10 contributing held-out diseases were cancers. The cancer stratum reproduces the pooled result; the single non-cancer disease showed no benefit. Outside oncology this score is untested rather than known to be wrong.

limitations.title: It cannot establish that a target is unpursued
limitations.detail: Open Targets records approved and clinical-stage drugs. It does not record failed, abandoned or unpublished programmes, so a target with no recorded effort may be one that was tried quietly and dropped. The manual checks on this page are what decide it.

limitations.title: Missing effort data is not zero effort
limitations.detail: Open Targets 21.04 tractability joined 72.8% of targets in the Task 8 benchmark. A target with no record has unknown prior chemistry, not none, and is excluded from these results rather than being shown as neglected.

limitations.title: It cannot tell you why a target was passed over
limitations.detail: Most of the zero-effort tail is there for reasons no public dataset records: no tractable pocket, no assay, no tool compound, a mechanism that failed in someone's unpublished work, or a target nobody can make a selective molecule against. Absence of effort is not evidence of a missed opportunity.

limitations.title: The evidence score is partly a measure of attention
limitations.detail: Publication count alone reaches ROC-AUC 0.667, against 0.721 for the full model, and that gain does not survive disease-level resampling for PR-AUC. So a high evidence score partly means a well-studied target, which is in tension with looking for neglected ones.

limitations.title: The understudied-target idea is not original to TargetForge
limitations.detail: The NIH Common Fund's Illuminating the Druggable Genome programme and its Pharos portal already classify targets by development level, and this repository reimplements that classification. What is added here is India disease-burden weighting and an evidence model with measured held-out performance.

limitations.title: Burden is WHO national data, not the ICMR/PHFI/IHME state-level series
limitations.detail: The India State-Level Disease Burden Initiative output is published as a PDF of typeset tables and the IHME GBD Results Tool has no open bulk endpoint, so WHO Global Health Estimates national DALYs are used instead. These will not match published GBD India figures and carry no state-level detail.

limitations.title: Most disease burden is unmapped
limitations.detail: WHO GHE cause labels are not ontology terms, and a mapping is accepted only on an exact label match to an EFO or MONDO disease. 82 of 189 non-aggregate causes are mapped; unmapped diseases show burden as unavailable.

limitations.title: The model was fitted on 2021 data and is being applied to today's
limitations.detail: The evidence model was fitted on Open Targets 21.04 (2021-05-05) and validated against outcomes to 26.09 (2026-09). Scoring current data assumes the relationship has not moved since, which has not been tested.

limitations.title: There is no market or commercial term, deliberately
limitations.detail: Burden is DALYs. No per-capita income, market size, willingness-to-pay or other commercial proxy enters the ranking at any point.
